newsitem.title: GREECE: FORECAST -Greek Sept inflation seen at 8.5 pct y/y.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST -Greek Sept inflation seen at 8.5 pct y/y.

text.p: Greece's consumer price inflation will remain steady at 8.5 percent year-on-year in September, according to Greek bankers and economists in an informal poll conducted by Reuters on Wednesday.
The fifteen participants in the poll produced a mean forecast of 8.5 percent for September CPI. Forecasts ranged between 8.4 and 8.6 percent.

Greece's consumer price inflation stood at 8.5 percent year-on-year in August. Core CPI inflation, which excludes volatile food and energy prices, fell to 8.2 percent year-on-year in August from 8.5 percent in July.
An official at the National Statistics Service (NSS) told Reuters the official CPI figure will be released either on Friday or next Monday. --Dimitris Kontogiannis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
